final_decision.rationale: Step 1 compression: block_boundary=5.177 (0%FP) confirms JPEG; severity curve in signal mode: jpeg5 61% / jpeg4 15% / jpeg3 40% diff -> sev4 minimum. Step 2 blur: DT glass (glass_score=1.58, sigma<3); signal verify matched blur:spectral_slope and blur:wiener_kernel (the only matched signals overall); glass:5 beat gaussian:5 by 0.32 dB; anisotropy=1.23 rules out motion. Step 3 global: variance_ratio=0.589 + contrast_spread_ratio=0.797; contrast_weaken_scale:1 improved PSNR +1.86 dB over no-global; sev2/3 monotonically worse; stretch always pulls mean to 0.5 (mean_shift diff 0.138, rejected); brightness gamma overshoots variance (70% diff, rejected); quantization ruled out by unique_G=219. Order: blur(prio1) -> jpeg -> contrast (jpeg-first beat contrast-first 24.83 vs 24.52 dB and block_boundary 15% vs 21%). Noise: sigma<2, structured peeled residual -> NO_NOISE. Residual imperfections (block_boundary 15%, variance_ratio 27%, mean_shift 0.031) come from stochastic glass shuffling and imperfect JPEG quality match; verdict kept UNCERTAIN per exp37 rules (PSNR<30 on deterministic steps).

reanalysis.method: Re-ran run_full_analysis.py on all 5 support pairs (full_analysis_R1.json, full_analysis_R1_p1..p4.json) and compared verdict vs signals, threshold boundaries, and second-order statistics; re-tested under-covered function families with test_candidate.py.
reanalysis.compression: COMPRESSION_DETECTED on 5/5 pairs (block_boundary 5.18/5.73/4.90/10.19/4.75, 0%FP). unique_G 219/230/232/177/240 -> quantization_median/hist impossible (they collapse to <=20-24 levels). dct_zero_ratio 0.888-0.907. Severity: R0 signal-mode block_boundary curve had minimum diff at jpeg4 (15%), worse at jpeg3 (40%) and jpeg5 (61%); R1 re-check reproduced 16% at jpeg4 -> jpeg:4 retained over the higher-PSNR jpeg2/3 (25.13/25.04 vs 24.83) because block_boundary is a 0%FP signal that must not be overridden by PSNR.
reanalysis.blur: Per-pair full analysis: glass on pairs 0-3 (glass_score 1.58/1.53/1.26/1.70; aniso 1.23/1.50/1.44/1.85) but motion on pair 4 (aniso=3.19). Cross-pair reconciliation: GT applies one blur function to all pairs; glass_score >1.25 on 5/5 pairs while aniso>1.7 on 1/5. R1 test motion:5,jpeg4,scale1 on pair 4 = 21.05 dB vs glass control 23.95 (-2.90 dB); visual inspection shows isotropic smear, no directional streak -> pair4 aniso is a content/JPEG-driven FP. Threshold-boundary check: gm_ratio=0.33 sits just below the 0.35 sev5 cutoff, and per-pair gm 0.13-0.54 gives content-dependent severity estimates 5/4/3/5/5; glass:4 vs 5 differ by only 0.06 dB (24.77 vs 24.83), sev5 kept as the calibrated reading.
reanalysis.deterministic_family_check: R0 tested gaussian:5 (24.51) but never lens or gaussian severity !=5; R1 added lens:5 (24.57) and gaussian:3 (24.31). If the GT blur were any deterministic function, the exact pipeline would reproduce at >35 dB; all deterministic candidates stay at 24.3-24.6 dB -> GT blur must be stochastic (glass), matching glass_score.
reanalysis.global: Second-order stat used: variance_ratio. Target pair0 = 0.589. Measured simulated vr with contrast_weaken_scale:1 = 0.4748 (over-weakened) and without global = 0.844 (under-weakened, derived from the 0.5625 variance factor); target is bracketed, and no milder pure-scale generator function exists (scale sev1=0.75 is the mildest). R0 scans: no-global 22.97, scale1 24.83, scale2 23.47, scale3 20.97. R1: mean-preserving contrast_weaken_stretch:2 (R0's stretch:1 is not identity despite its docstring; the formula 1/(1+(mean/img)^c) is strongly nonlinear) = 15.26 dB -> stretch family rejected. Per-channel mean shifts are sign-inconsistent across pairs (pair0 R+6.6/G+2.1/B+18.1; pair1 R+4.7; pair2 G+2.2; pair3 R+13.2/B+14.8; pair4 all negative; sim 0.0035 vs target 0.0351), so the mean_shift mismatch is JPEG chroma subsampling, not brightness (brightness shift sev1=+0.1 would also be 3x too large and channel-uniform). Full-analysis global verdict flips CONTRAST/SATURATION across pairs, but saturation cannot produce vr 0.38-0.69 (luma variance) -> contrast_weaken_scale retained.

validation.change_criterion: CHANGE requires pair0 improvement >2 dB or >35 dB (deterministic) with other pairs not worse. Best R1 candidate is control itself; all alternatives are 0.26-9.57 dB worse on pair0 (and motion 2.90 dB worse on pair4). No >35 dB signature appeared -> criterion not met.

decision.rationale: All R1 signal re-interpretation (cross-pair glass consistency, quantization impossibility via unique_G, JPEG severity via 0%FP block_boundary, variance bracketing, channel-resolved mean shifts, noise gate) supports the R0 pipeline; every alternative tested in R1 is worse and no deterministic candidate shows the >35 dB exact-match signature. Residual gaps (bb 16%, mean_shift 0.0316, variance_ratio 28%) are irreducible given the discrete function set and glass stochasticity, matching R0 exactly within 0.03 dB.
